historical_references.reference: Aiyub was a Chola king who ruled from 1118 to 1133 CE. He is known for his military conquests, particularly the invasion of the Hoysala kingdom in the south.

Aiyub is also known as Aiyadparunthavar Kulothunga Chola III. He is considered an important figure in the revival of the Jain faith in the southern part of India during the 13th century. He is known to have built several Jain temples during his rule.
